title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - Incentive
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/Incentive. An Incentive indicates the intersection of a tier with a slot. In this particular combination of slot and tier there are a particular costs to draw this type of energy. For example, drawing power from the grid costs 0.30 euro per kilowatthour during the afternoon, but will only be activated from a lower boundary of 3000W. Subclass of DataPoint per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the DataPoint model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Incentive'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasLowerBoundary.description: Relationship. This property relates an IncentiveTableBoundary to the datapoint describing its lower boundary or starting point at which this boundary becomes active. Relationship to DataPoint.

hasUpperBoundary.description: Relationship. This property relates a boundary to its upper boundary or the value at which this incentive becomes inactive. This value is optional, because the upper boundary can be inferred from the lower boundary of the next boundary. Relationship to DataPoint.
